bullets: On Friday 20 November, DLD recorded 377 sales worth AED 745m, which is 1.2% above a typical weekday.
Off-plan sales made up 63.4% of the total, compared to 59.2% over the last seven days.
The median price per square foot was AED 1,836, up 9.1% from the 30-day average and down 2.1% from last year.
Over the last seven days, the busiest areas were JVC with 198 sales, Business Bay with 139 sales, and Saih Shuaib 1 with 133 sales.
In October new contracts, JVC 1BR apartments had a median rent of AED 69,812 a year, up 1.2% on the month.
talking_points: Recent reports show significant historical capital appreciation across the local residential market, with property prices surging 18 percent.
Dubai property market weekly transactions recently hit $3.3 billion, indicating strong liquidity and sustained investor confidence.
Buyer preferences are shifting, with buyers increasingly preferring ready properties over off-plan.
